lines: Maria da Silva joined the research group
after working with a museum in São Paulo.
Her first task was to catalogue photographs
that had never been shown to the public.
Some images had dates on the back,
while others carried only a family name.
Instead of guessing where they belonged,
she kept a separate list of uncertain records.
Local residents later helped the museum
identify several people in those pictures.
